# Annual Report Forensic Analyst v2.1.1

## Summary

First public release of a forensic annual report analysis framework. It treats annual reports as evidence and tests management narratives against financial reality, cash generation, returns, capital allocation, and changing success assumptions.

## Installation

- Codex users: download `Annual_Report_Forensic_Analyst_v2.1.1_Codex_Skill_Install_Package.zip` and follow [INSTALLATION.md](../INSTALLATION.md).
- Developers and contributors: download the GitHub Repository Package or clone the repository.

## Main features

- Fact / Inference / Analyst View separation
- Single-Year Forensic Mode
- Multi-Year Forensic Mode
- Executive Slide Mode
- Capital Allocation Review logic
- Codex integration

## Limitations

This release does not provide investment recommendations, stock ratings, target prices, valuation models, or unsupported forecasts. Conclusions must disclose evidence limitations and uncertainty.
